title: The Flowers of Evil
author: Bakaboss
reason: The Flowers of Evil is underrated because it explores uncomfortable human psychology—obsession, shame, and moral ambiguity—in a raw, unfiltered way that mainstream readers often avoid. Its intense focus on internal conflict and flawed, toxic characters challenges conventional storytelling, making it less accessible and less appealing to a wider audience.

reason:
Kokudo and Hitsujiya performs hacks and learn more about their strange nature. If the hack is performed wrong the results can be drastic

This is written by ONE, the author of One Punch Man and Mob Psycho 100. The art is good and the way it story revolves around is great. The characters are not dumb they do things with precautions so that things doesn't go wrong.The sci-fi and horror elements makes it shine with mysteries of the hacks.
description:

Hitsujiya attempts to do the same thing, but if a hack’s directions aren’t followed precisely, the results can be devastating!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: All My Neighbors are Convinced the Female Knight from My Rice Field Is My Wife
author: Arken
reason:
Jin Mita found a female knight in his rice paddy and from there the story beings. It is a Reverse Isekai story.

Reverse Isekai are something fresh for me. In a countryside with a Isekai'd Knight living everyday day to day life. Gives you feel good vibe. The story does shows the aniexty of Seraphim(Isekai'd Knight) not able to return and of the new environment around her but doesn't focus on that much.

It is a Slice of Life Iyashikei Story set in Rural are and exploring day to day adventure in village. Little bit like Barakamon

description: After being recently discharged from military service and just drifting through life, Hanbin Ryu is suddenly transported to another world. However, his “guide line,” the system bestowed upon him to help with his survival and growth, was filled with errors, causing him to be stuck in the tutorial stage for over 20 years. When he is finally released from this personal hell, he finds everyone has turned against otherworlders like him. Just how will this low-level, super-tutorial newbie survive?
